basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the Research Associate III post is 35 years on the date of interview.

qualification.details: Previous experience in handling systematic review projects related to the medical field. Basic knowledge about biostatistics and research paper writing. Preference will be given to the candidate with Publications (Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis) as first or corresponding author in SCIE Q1 journals. High-level expertise for conducting data analysis using R Programming: STATA, Python.

salary_details.details: The work will be reviewed six monthly and further extension will be provided with total duration of project being 3 years.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview at Department of Pharmacology
Room No. 233. Screening test may be conducted
in the case of large number of candidates.
how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed application form and bio-data format from the notification.
Fill in the application form in the prescribed format.
Prepare all necessary documents in favour of your eligibility about qualification and experience.
Ensure you appear in person for the walk-in interview on the specified date.

Report at Room number 233, Department of Pharmacology, Second Floor, Institutional Block, AIIMS Jodhpur on 16 October 2026 at 11:00 AM along with the filled application form, bio-data, and all relevant original documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by AIIMS Jodhpur to hire 1 temporary Research Associate-III for a DHR sponsored project entitled "Technical Resource Centre under the Centre for Evidence for Guideline".

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree Or MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech/M.Sc with at least 3 year of research experience and one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) Journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years on the date of interview, with relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application form in the prescribed format and attend the walk-in interview in person with their bio-data and all relevant original documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an interview, and a screening test may be conducted if there is a large number of candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of INR 67,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Room number 233, Department of Pharmacology, Second Floor, Institutional Block, AIIMS Jodhpur.
